parts.mn: A collar and two flapping sleeves. Clothing (浴衣, yukata).

parts.label: Window
parts.mn: A stall at a bright window. Trade, goods (商品).

parts.label: Stop
parts.mn: A hill that stops you. Limit.

parts.label: Shared
parts.mn: Earth spread out evenly. Level, all one price (均一).

parts.label: Broom
parts.mn: A woman with a broom in old pictures. Wife, lady (婦人).

parts.label: Hand
parts.mn: A hand dressing a kneeling body. Clothes.

parts.label: Say
parts.mn: A man with a fine sash who speaks with care. Gentleman.

parts.label: Warrior
parts.mn: A warrior standing broad and tall. Gentleman, samurai.

parts.label: Master
parts.mn: The master's horse, kept still. Park (駐車場).

parts.label: Desk
parts.mn: Calm at a wooden desk. Plan, guide (案内).

parts.label: See
parts.mn: A jewel you can see right now. Present, appear (現在, now).

parts.label: Earth
parts.mn: A sprout in the earth. Exist, be there.

parts.label: Square
parts.mn: A carpenter's tool. Craft, construction (工事).

parts.label: Yellow
parts.mn: A yellow wooden bar laid sideways. Across (横断, crossing).

parts.label: Axe
parts.mn: An axe chopping through. Cut, cross (横断).

parts.label: Against
parts.mn: Turning back along the road. Return.

parts.label: Kneel
parts.mn: Kneel and step back. Withdraw (返却, give back).

parts.label: Stool
parts.mn: Walking to a stool to sort things out. Deal with (処方, prescribe).

parts.label: Plough
parts.mn: A plough pointing one way. Direction, way.

parts.label: Thin
parts.mn: Thin strips of bamboo for writing. Slip of paper (処方箋).

parts.label: Flesh
parts.mn: The field in your flesh where food goes. Stomach.

parts.label: Unroll
parts.mn: Flesh that unrolls on and on. Intestines.

parts.label: Upside down
parts.mn: A person turned upside down. Change (化粧, make-up).

parts.label: House
parts.mn: Rice powder dusted on at home. Adorn, make-up.

parts.label: Piled high
parts.mn: Fire piled high. Burn (日焼け, sunburn).

parts.label: Shell
parts.mn: Money for a duty. Fee, fare (賃走).

parts.label: Look up
parts.mn: Looking up the road for someone. Welcome, pick up (迎車).

parts.label: Pass
parts.mn: Passing it along the road. Send (回送).

parts.label: Layers
parts.mn: Layers of earth piling up. Increase (割増, surcharge).

parts.label: Power
parts.mn: Power to shift something heavy. Move (自動, automatic).

parts.label: Wings
parts.mn: Two wings pulling apart. Not, un- (非常, emergency).

parts.label: Cloth
parts.mn: Cloth always hanging under the roof. Usual (非常, out of the usual).

parts.label: Together
parts.mn: A hill everyone struggles up together. Steep, danger (危険).

parts.label: Punish
parts.mn: Taking another road to avoid punishment. Avoid, shelter (避難).

parts.label: Smaller
parts.mn: Water making the fire smaller and smaller. Put out (消火器).

parts.label: Dog
parts.mn: A dog guarding the pots. Container, tool.

parts.label: Strike
parts.mn: An old action. Reason, past (故障, breakdown).

parts.label: Badge
parts.mn: A hill blocking the way. Hinder (故障, out of order).

parts.label: Say
parts.mn: Speaking humbly at the altar. God (神社, shrine).

parts.label: Rays
parts.mn: Light across the scene casts a shadow. Shadow, image (撮影, photography).

parts.label: Daring
parts.mn: Daring on a cliff edge with sparks flying. Strict (厳禁, strictly banned).

parts.label: Offering
parts.mn: Hands raised with an offering. Worship, view humbly (拝観).

parts.label: See
parts.mn: A heron watching the water. View (観光, sightseeing).

parts.label: Head
parts.mn: Heads following each other like a river. Order (順路, the route).

parts.label: Each
parts.mn: Each foot on its way. Road, route.

parts.label: Hand
parts.mn: A hand under the roof. Protect (お守り, charm).

parts.label: Clothing
parts.mn: Clothes spread out on display. Unfold, exhibit (展望台).

parts.label: King
parts.mn: A lost king gazing at the moon. Hope, gaze (展望, view).

parts.label: Box
parts.mn: A box you lean your elbow on. Stand, platform.

parts.label: Field
parts.mn: A field. Doors open onto a field you stay in a while. Stay, as in 留学 (study abroad).

parts.label: Run
parts.mn: Running. Those who go along on foot behind a teacher: pupils (生徒).

parts.label: Cover
parts.mn: Something that covers the head. A cloth that covers the head: a hat.

parts.label: Moon
parts.mn: A crescent moon rising, half hidden. Evening.

parts.label: Cow
parts.mn: A cow's head seen from the front, with one horn. Cow.

parts.label: Hook
parts.mn: Something bent. A mother bent over her child, giving milk.

parts.label: Two hands
parts.mn: Two hands. Two hands holding a box tucked against the elbow: a lunch box (弁当).

parts.label: Fruit
parts.mn: Fruit. Fruit from plants made into sweets.

parts.label: East
parts.mn: A bundle tied up. Twisting thread over and over until it's strong: practice.

parts.label: White
parts.mn: A white chick. A young bird flapping its wings again and again to learn to fly.

parts.label: Surplus
parts.mn: Extra earth. Clearing extra earth off a hill: remove, as in 掃除 (cleaning).

parts.label: Pheasant
parts.mn: A pheasant splashing its wings. Splashing in water: rinse, as in 洗濯 (laundry).

parts.label: Hand
parts.mn: A hand measuring out land among the trees. A village.

parts.label: Companions
parts.mn: Two moons side by side. Planks of wood laid side by side: a shelf.

parts.label: Thread
parts.mn: A thin thread. A thread vanishing into the dark. 玄関 is the entrance.

parts.label: Bar
parts.mn: A bar across it. A barred gate: a checkpoint, as in 玄関 (entrance).

parts.label: Hand with tool
parts.mn: A hand cutting them. Steps cut into stone: stairs (階段).

parts.label: Court
parts.mn: An open courtyard. The open space by the house: a garden.

parts.label: Window
parts.mn: A window facing out. The window faces that way: towards, over there (向こう).

parts.label: Dot
parts.mn: With an extra dot. Even bigger than big: fat, thick.

parts.label: Field
parts.mn: A field. Thread as fine as the lines between fields: thin.

parts.label: Child
parts.mn: A child sheltering under a thick cliff from the sun.

parts.label: Spread
parts.mn: Spread out. Grass spread thin on water: thin, weak.

parts.label: Sound
parts.mn: Sound. When the sun is gone, you only have sound to go by: dark.

parts.label: Bent
parts.mn: Something bent and broken. Water that's gone bad: dirty.

parts.label: Hand
parts.mn: A hand. Hands working the earth to build a temple.

parts.label: Cloud
parts.mn: A cloud. A cloud over the sun: cloudy.

parts.label: Yawn
parts.mn: Someone breathing out. Breath from the mouth: blow.

parts.label: Work
parts.mn: Work. Sorting sheep by hand to see how they differ: difference, as in 交差点.

parts.label: Fire
parts.mn: Four sparks. Sparks leaving dots: a point.

parts.label: Spread
parts.mn: Spread level both ways. A flat, level plank: flat, as in 平仮名.

parts.label: Opposite
parts.mn: Turned the other way. A person in disguise: temporary, as in 仮名 (kana).

parts.label: Half tree
parts.mn: Half of a split tree trunk. One side, a piece, as in 片仮名.

parts.label: Early
parts.mn: The sun rising. Standing up to read the first page as the sun rises: a chapter.

parts.label: See
parts.mn: Light under the cover lets you see: wake up and remember.

parts.label: Frame
parts.mn: A frame split in two. Two halves of one thing: both, as in 両親.

parts.label: Big
parts.mn: Rice stored deep inside a big house. Inner, as in 奥さん (wife).

parts.label: Power
parts.mn: Power. Planting with full power: force, and a crowd (大勢).

parts.label: Root
parts.mn: A root, the trunk. A person's trunk: the body.

parts.label: Self
parts.mn: A nose, which you point at to mean yourself.

parts.label: Shell
parts.mn: Money. Giving money to stand in for a while: lend.

parts.label: Long ago
parts.mn: Long ago. A person who borrowed long ago and still hasn't paid.

parts.label: Head
parts.mn: A head. Bowing your head with a bundle of gifts to ask a favour: rely on.

parts.label: Sheep
parts.mn: A sheep. Waves like sheep across the water: the ocean, and things from over it (洋服).

parts.label: Power
parts.mn: Power. Putting your strength into the clay every day: work (勤める).

parts.label: Gate
parts.mn: Two doors of a gate. Gate.

parts.label: Mark
parts.mn: Marking a spot. Sticking a shell on a marked spot: paste, stick.

parts.label: Rows
parts.mn: Two people standing on one line. Line up.

parts.label: Earth
parts.mn: Earth. Earth piled up to push people aside: a wall.

parts.label: Spoon
parts.mn: A person fallen over. A person turned to bones: die.

parts.label: Tree
parts.mn: A tree. A tree boxed in with no room to grow: stuck, in trouble.

parts.label: Leather
parts.mn: Feet going opposite ways. Walking different ways down the road: differ.

parts.label: Single
parts.mn: One thing. Plucking a single string like a bow: play (an instrument).

parts.label: Meet
parts.mn: Meeting. Threads meeting to make a pattern: a picture.

parts.label: Bird
parts.mn: A bird, with an eye, feathers and feet. Bird.

parts.label: Bird
parts.mn: A bird. A bird opening its mouth: an animal's cry.

parts.label: Stand
parts.mn: A tall stand. Feet climbing up onto a high stand: climb.

parts.label: Snake
parts.mn: A coiled snake. Water lying coiled in a hollow: a pond.

parts.label: Open
parts.mn: Opening wide. A mouth opening into a smile: a flower blooms.

parts.label: Platform
parts.mn: A platform. A woman stepping onto the stage to begin.

parts.label: Carve
parts.mn: Water dripping from carved wood. Thread dyed with the sap of green plants: green.

parts.label: Dot
parts.mn: A dot. Nine rolled into a ball with a dot: round.

parts.label: Plate
parts.mn: A dish on a stand, seen from the side. Plate.

parts.label: Plate
parts.mn: A plate of white crystals scraped from the earth: salt.

parts.label: Pig
parts.mn: A pig. Pig meat: pork, and pig.

parts.label: Bird
parts.mn: A bird. A bird kept tied up in the yard: chicken.
